correctness.rationale: Bijection between self-adjoint endomorphisms supported on one totally isotropic image U and symmetric maps U*→U is exact. Image-spanning iff zero common radical; subspace Möbius inversion yields each rank vector; orthogonal frame counting gives the Witt-type factor. Independent literal-matrix enumeration reproduces rank-vector distributions for split and nonsplit ternary four-spaces and odd three-spaces of orders three and five. Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of the all-parameter statement.
